title: Shikin prepared database mutation recovery journal record
description: Durable, append-only recovery evidence prepared before a restore or import mutation. Proof verification retains filesystem evidence for the lock-owned mutation-entry protocol without wiring a database adapter.

x-shikin-canonical-json.recordFileTerminator: exactly one LF excluded from record hash

x-shikin-platform-durability.semantics: Every non-Linux platform fails after input or proof validation and before journal path creation, evidence verification, or proof issuance.

x-shikin-preparation-retry: An existing operation directory is always RECOVERY_PREPARATION_INCOMPLETE, whether partial, complete, or malicious. Preparation never parses, deletes, resumes, or mints a proof from existing disk evidence, and this version exposes no cleanup API.
x-shikin-commit-point: A proof may be returned only on Linux after the complete final record and both artifacts are flushed, sealed to mode 0400, required directory synchronization is complete, and a full reread verifies canonical bytes, names, hashes, opened sizes, identities, privacy, links, binding, and retained-handle size, mtime, and ctime snapshots across both artifact hashes.

x-shikin-proof-boundary.mutationAuthority: A prepared proof and its verified token are evidence only; mutation authority exists only after the lock durably publishes the exact shikin.recovery.protocol, shikin.recovery.version, shikin.recovery.recordSha256, shikin.recovery.durability, and shikin.recovery.claimSequence commitment.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.fullVerification: Before taking the registration mutex, proof verification fully rereads and hashes the record and both artifacts, verifies every binding and layout invariant, and retains close-on-exec handles for the operation root, recovery root, operations root, operation, artifacts, records, record, candidate, and rollback paths.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.tokenLifecycle: Exactly one opaque verified token may be active per unused proof. Release is idempotent and keeps the proof unused; consume marks the proof used before no-retry handle closure.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.mutexRevalidation: Under the registration mutex, the lock performs bounded layout, reopened no-follow path identity, retained-handle identity, exact immutable snapshot, and second retained-handle checks without content reads or hashes.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.mutableRoots: The lock-owned operation root and shared recovery and operations roots require canonical retained identity, directory type, sane link evidence, and private mode, but do not compare size, mtime, ctime, or link-count equality because valid coordination and sibling preparation mutate them.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.immutableEvidence: The operation-specific operation, artifacts, and records directories and the prepared record and artifact files require exact identity, type, mode, link, size, mtime, ctime, and expected-layout continuity.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.adapterUse: A future adapter must validate the committed artifact immediately before using it.
x-shikin-proof-boundary.trustModel: The same OS principal is trusted; retained continuity evidence does not claim defense against a hostile same-user process.

createdAt.description: The exact creation timestamp of the bound exclusive intent, not journal publication time. updatedAt, metadata, and stateRevision are proof-only and are not persisted here.

strictTimestamp.x-shikin-validation: Implementations must parse and exactly round-trip the timestamp, rejecting normalized impossible dates and hour 24.
